description: scmp(x, 0) not folded to sext(x) under assume((x + 1) <u 3)
notes: C translated from the IR reproducer in the issue: __builtin_assume((uint32_t)x + 1u < 3u) produces the issue's offset-form assume, and (x > 0) - (x < 0) widened to int64_t produces llvm.scmp.i64.i32. expected.ll from the issue target (sext), with the assume kept. Writing the precondition as x >= -1 && x <= 1 instead makes clang emit two signed compares, and then it already folds to sext: the miss is specific to the offset form, as the issue explains. expected.ll proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 alive-tv, 2026-10-28: src = clang trunk -O3 IR of src.c (godbolt cclang_trunk, -O3 --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -march=skylake -emit-llvm -S -g0) renamed @src, tgt = expected.ll renamed @tgt, identical signature; output 'Transformation seems to be correct!' with no warning. Run on Alive2's own Compiler Explorer instance (alive2.llvm.org/ce, compiler id 'alive'), since godbolt.org does not host alive-tv.
